description: This file defines a PHP class 'ApiGatewayManagementApiClient' that extends 'AwsClient' and provides methods to interact with the Amazon API Gateway Management API service, including connection management and messaging functionalities.

classes.name: ApiGatewayManagementApiClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AmazonApiGatewayManagementApi service, providing methods for managing WebSocket connections.

methods.name: deleteConnection
methods.description: Deletes a WebSocket connection identified by the provided connection ID.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific WebSocket connection.

methods.name: postToConnection
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific WebSocket connection.

methods.name: postToConnectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a message to a WebSocket connection.
